verdict.rationale: The Server Administration Guide documents built-in brute force protection, which temporarily or permanently disables accounts after too many login failures and emits events for it. That covers the brute-force part of the story. Nothing in the evidence addresses bot mitigation or credential-stuffing defenses, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: bot protection (e.g. CAPTCHA or bot detection), credential-stuffing defenses (e.g. breached-password checks, IP or rate-based throttling), lockout configuration details, independent corroboration.
